---
# `title` stays empty so the hero below is the only heading on the page.
# `pagetitle` sets the browser tab and og:title without Quarto appending the
# site name — otherwise the share preview reads "– Laura Burnett".
title: ""
pagetitle: "Laura Burnett — Research Data Scientist"
# Suppress the site-name suffix here; pagetitle already contains her name, so
# without this the tab reads "…Research Data Scientist – Laura Burnett".
title-prefix: ""
# Set explicitly: without it Quarto picks the first image on the page (the hero
# brain SVG), and social scrapers won't render an SVG.
image: "/assets/social-card.png"
description: "Research data scientist with ten years in neuroscience labs, building analysis pipelines that turn large, complex experimental datasets into open resources."
# `full` rather than `article`: the featured-project grid needs more than the
# 720px reading measure. custom.scss caps it at 1040px via
# `.content:has(.project-grid)`, and `.hero .bio` keeps its own 640px measure
# so the intro text still reads at a comfortable width.
page-layout: full
toc: false
title-block-style: none
# Card titles are <h3>. Without this, anchor-sections injects an <a> into each
# one — nested inside the card's own <a>, which is invalid HTML.
anchor-sections: false
# The same listing and card template as projects/index.qmd, capped at the first
# three by `priority`, so the homepage selection can never drift from the
# grid's own ordering.
listing:
  - id: featured-projects
    template: _project-card.ejs
    contents:
      - "projects/*.qmd"
      - "!projects/index.qmd"
    sort: "priority asc"
    max-items: 3
---
